column1: #   Reproducing CONUS+'s S/B is NOT a coherent test for this pipeline -- they sit at
#   7.4 m.w.e. behind a shield this project does not model
#   would require inventing a model of their shield.  CONSEQUENCE: THE MILESTONE

#   NUMERATOR.  Their measured S/B ~ 0.03 is retained as CONTEXT for a shielded
#   experiment and is explicitly NOT a gate and NOT a target.
# GEOMETRIC RESCALE
#   P_c = 3.6 GW_th
#   Assumes a point source
#   SPECTRAL SHAPE at both sites.  The fission-fraction difference between the 3 GW_th
#   reference core and CONUS+'s Leibstadt core is a NAMED
#   this project holds nothing that could quantify it
column2: and no guessed correction is folded in.

column1: # CONUS+ SM EXPECTATION: 347 +/- 59 events in 327 kg.d
#   as a rate: 347 / 327 counts/kg/day
#   CONUS+ Collab.
#   ancillary data exists to download.
# KINEMATIC SUPPORT of our dR/dT: the largest T with non-zero dR/dT is 3031.6858 eV_nr
#   (the table runs to 3165.6057 eV_nr but carries exact zeros above the endpoint).
#   A window above it records a ZERO rate with an above_kinematic_endpoint flag; it is
#   never a silently truncated integral (fp-silent-endpoint-truncation)
#   was extended to make any window reachable.
# IA BROADENING IS OMITTED and its size is MEASURED
#   expectation contains no impulse-approximation kernel
#   the unbroadened dR/dT.  sigma_E/E_R = sqrt(omega_bar/E_R) with the CONVENTIONS
#   Section J locked omega_bar = 1.7859677040e-02 eV:
#     at the pre-registered lower edge 2116.49 eV_nr: 2.904884e-03
#     at the pre-registered upper edge 4742.51 eV_nr: 1.940585e-03
#   Direction: a symmetric kernel on a falling spectrum near an endpoint moves counts
#   BOTH ways across a window edge; at these fractional widths the effect is far below
#   the decades the window choice moves
column2: which is why it is not the story here.

column1: # INDEPENDENT ROUTE (not an algebraic identity of this plan): cevns.conus_rescale_check
#   compares our flagship flux model against Billard's independently normalized one at
#   the CONUS+ geometry.  R_ours_at_conus = 1.185887e+02
#   ratio = 0.991302.  The two routes AGREE on the absolute rate scale to 0.87%.
#   BUT THAT AGREEMENT DOES NOT REACH THE WINDOW
column2: and saying so is the point of this

column1: #   block.  conus_rescale_check integrates from a 50 eV recoil floor and that integral
#   is overwhelmingly low-T.  MEASURED
#     rate above the 50 eV floor              = 67.760571 counts/kg/day
#     fraction of it above the PRE-REGISTERED lower edge = 4.722893e-06
#     fraction of it above the ALTERNATE lower edge      = 7.456330e-03
#   So the 1%-level Billard agreement constrains the BULK normalization and says
#   essentially NOTHING about the 2-5 keV_nr tail the pre-registered window probes.
#   It is evidence that the chain's overall scale is sound; it is NOT evidence that
#   the endpoint region is right
column2: and it must not be read as the latter.

column3: 1.764657e+00; central-k alternate within the factor: True
